conservation_status.note_en: The global status is Endangered and the population trend is decreasing.
conservation_status.note_zh: 全球等级为濒危，种群趋势下降。

description.en: The African wild dog is a long-legged, highly social canid whose irregular black, brown, yellow and white coat is unique to each individual. Cooperative hunting and shared pup care are strengths, but the large connected landscapes packs require are disappearing.
description.zh: 非洲野犬是长腿、高度社会化的犬科动物，每只个体的黑、褐、黄、白斑纹都独一无二。合作狩猎和共同育幼是其优势，但犬群所需的大型连通景观正在消失。

anatomy.en: Adults generally weigh about 18–36 kg. A lean body, long legs, large rounded ears and only 4 toes on each foot distinguish the species; coat patterns vary individually and the bushy tail often ends in white.
anatomy.zh: 成体通常重约18–36千克。瘦长身体、长腿、大圆耳和每足仅4趾是主要特征；斑纹因个体而异，蓬松尾巴常有白色尾端。

ecology_and_behavior.en: Packs pursue medium-sized antelope and other prey in coordinated chases, then share food with pups and dependent adults. A breeding pair usually produces most pups, while other pack members guard, feed and move with them.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 犬群通过协调追逐捕食中型羚羊等猎物，再与幼崽和依赖群体的成体分享食物。通常由一对繁殖个体产下多数幼崽，其他成员负责守护、喂食和共同移动。

habitat_and_distribution.en: Formerly widespread in sub-Saharan Africa, the species now survives in fragmented savannas, grasslands, open woodlands and scrub, with major strongholds in southern and eastern Africa.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 该物种曾广布撒哈拉以南非洲，如今仅在破碎的稀树草原、草地、疏林和灌丛中存续，主要核心区位于非洲南部和东部。

habitat.text_en: Open plains and savannas of Sub-Saharan Africa
habitat.text_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的开阔平原和稀树草原

range_review.comparison_en: The previous center, zoom and polygon coordinates are retained exactly. Authoritative text supports the broad distribution, but reusable authoritative boundary geometry was unavailable; the legacy polygon is labelled approximate, not verified.
range_review.comparison_zh: 原有中心点、缩放和多边形坐标完全保留。权威文字支持大致分布，但未获得可复用的权威边界几何；原多边形标为近似范围，而非已核实边界。

life_cycle_and_reproduction.en: After about 10 weeks of gestation, pups are born in a den and remain there during the first weeks. The pack brings food to the nursing female and later regurgitates food for pups; young eventually travel with the group.
life_cycle_and_reproduction.zh: 妊娠约10周后，幼崽在巢穴中出生，最初数周留在洞内。犬群为哺乳雌犬带回食物，之后为幼崽反刍喂食；幼犬最终随群移动。

detail.en: Long limbs and a light build support sustained pursuit rather than short ambushes.
detail.zh: 长肢和轻盈体型适合持续追逐，而非短程伏击。

detail.en: Broad mobile ears improve hearing and help release heat during activity.
detail.zh: 宽大可动耳朵增强听觉，也帮助活动时散热。

detail.en: Coordinated hunting, food sharing and alloparental care spread risk across the group.
detail.zh: 协调狩猎、分享食物和共同育幼把风险分散到整个群体。

ecological_role.en: As coursing predators, wild dogs influence prey behavior and carcass availability and connect food-web processes across very large home ranges.
ecological_role.zh: 作为追逐型捕食者，非洲野犬会影响猎物行为和尸体资源，并在超大活动范围内连接食物网过程。

threats.en: Habitat fragmentation, road deaths, conflict with livestock owners and infectious diseases from domestic dogs isolate and eliminate packs.
threats.zh: 生境破碎化、道路死亡、与畜牧者冲突以及家犬传播的传染病，会隔离并消灭犬群。

actions.en: Maintain connected landscapes, reduce road and livestock conflict, vaccinate domestic dogs around reserves and coordinate monitoring across borders.
actions.zh: 应维持连通景观，减少道路和牲畜冲突，为保护地周边家犬接种疫苗，并开展跨境协调监测。

key_features.en: Long-legged canid with huge round ears, a mottled multicolor coat, white-tipped tail and 4 toes per foot.
key_features.zh: 长腿犬科动物，耳朵巨大而圆，体表多色斑驳，尾端白色，每足4趾。

similar_species.en: Feral dogs and jackals may overlap, but neither consistently combines the irregular painted coat, very large ears, white tail tip and 4-toed feet. Distant images remain unsafe.
similar_species.zh: 野化家犬和胡狼可能同域，但通常没有不规则彩绘斑、大圆耳、白尾端和4趾的完整组合；远距离图像仍不足以确认。

communication_and_senses.en: Whines, twittering calls, barks, posture, scent and close greeting ceremonies coordinate departures, reunions, pup care and access to food.
communication_and_senses.zh: 呜咽、啁啾样叫声、吠声、姿势、气味和密切问候仪式可协调出发、重聚、育幼和取食顺序。

seasonal_calendar.en: Breeding timing differs regionally; denning temporarily restricts pack movement, while rains alter prey distribution, water and road conditions.
seasonal_calendar.zh: 繁殖时间因地区而异；育幼洞期会暂时限制犬群移动，降雨则改变猎物分布、水源和道路状况。

relationship_with_humans.en: Wild dogs rarely threaten people but can be killed after real or perceived livestock losses. Predator-proof husbandry and rapid compensation or response programs can reduce retaliation.
relationship_with_humans.zh: 非洲野犬很少威胁人类，却可能因实际或被认为的牲畜损失而遭杀害。防捕食畜牧措施和快速补偿或响应计划可减少报复。

evolution.en: Lycaon pictus is the only living species in its genus and differs from Canis in dentition and the loss of the first digit on the forefoot.
evolution.zh: 非洲野犬是非洲野犬属唯一现生种，在牙齿结构以及前足第一趾缺失方面与犬属不同。

field_signs.en: Pack tracks show 4 toe pads, but can resemble domestic-dog tracks. Multiple parallel trails, den activity, white-tipped animals and characteristic twittering calls improve confidence.
field_signs.zh: 犬群足迹显示4个趾垫，但可能类似家犬。多条平行路径、巢穴活动、白尾端个体和特征性啁啾叫声可提高判断把握。

text.en: Every animal carries a different coat pattern.
text.zh: 每只个体都有不同的斑纹。

text.en: Nonbreeding adults help feed and guard pups.
text.zh: 非繁殖成体也会喂养和守护幼崽。

text.en: A pack's need for space makes roads and fences important conservation issues.
text.zh: 犬群对大空间的需求使道路和围栏成为重要保护问题。

content.en: Hunting, reproduction, pup feeding and defense are distributed among pack members; losing a few key adults can disrupt the performance of the entire group.
content.zh: 狩猎、繁殖、幼崽喂养和防御由群体成员分担；失去少数关键成体就可能破坏整个犬群的运作。
